William Shakespeare is the man who wrote Hamlet. He was an English poet whose birthplace was Stratford-upon-Avon. The Globe Theatre, which was built in London, is the theatre that showed his plays. Today there is a replica which visitors can see. Shakespeare, who died in 1616, wrote 37 plays. There isn't any other English writer who is more famous.

Folha quatro. Escolha a marca e toque na palavra: o que se conta, ou o que não se conta.
Folha cinco. Olhe se a frase diz que tem, se ela nega ou se ela pergunta. Depois escolha.

Folha nove. Preencha a conversa: some, any, much ou many.
